title: Modal Verbs: Obligation & Advice

vocab.ex: Must expresses strong obligation.
Don't have to means no obligation.
Must not expresses prohibition.
Should is used to give advice.
Have to often refers to external rules.
Must often expresses the speaker's own feeling.
Ought to is a formal way to recommend something.
You need to bring your passport.
You must wear a uniform at work.
You have to arrive on time for the meeting.
You should study hard for the exam.
You must book in advance for this restaurant.
You should see a doctor about that cough.
You have to bring your passport to the airport.
You must not park here.
You must not smoke inside the building.
You should wash your hands before eating.
We have to pay the bill by Friday.
You ought to apologize to her.
You need to get travel insurance.
I have to renew my passport this year.
You should take a break, you look tired.
Employees must follow the safety rules.
You must wear a seatbelt in the car.
You don't have to ask permission to leave early today.
You should save money every month.
You must be on time for the interview.
You ought to check the schedule before you go.
You have to cancel the reservation by tomorrow.
You need to fill out this form.

expressions.example: You'd better call her before it's too late.
Visiting the old town is a must.
No need to worry, everything is fine.
I really should call my parents more often.

sentences: You must wear a uniform at work.
You don't have to come if you're busy.
You should see a doctor about that cough.
We have to pay the bill by Friday.
You ought to apologize to her.
You need to bring your passport.
You'd better hurry, the train leaves soon.

grammar.title: Modal Verbs: Obrigação e Conselho
rules: Must expressa obrigação forte, geralmente uma opinião pessoal de quem fala: I must call her today.
Have to expressa obrigação vinda de uma regra externa: I have to wear a uniform at work.
Must not expressa proibição: You must not smoke here. Don't have to expressa AUSÊNCIA de obrigação: You don't have to come.
Should e ought to dão conselhos, não são tão fortes quanto must: You should rest more.

rows: I have to wear a uniform.

quiz.q: You ___ wear a seatbelt in the car.
You ___ come to the party if you don't want to.
You ___ see a doctor about that cough.
